title: Parquet/Iceberg evidence materialization (design or bounded demonstration, with Pan)
objective: Map Moonshot's canonical artifacts to PostgreSQL metadata, content-addressed objects, Parquet event data and Iceberg history; an idempotent, recoverable materializer that never gates the authoritative publication; lake location agreed with Pan.
problem: Scientific evidence must be analysable in Pan's lake without the lake becoming a dependency of publication.
non_goals: writes to schema pan / pan_iceberg or the lake before Pan agrees
evidence_required: design section in the contract; if Pan agrees, a bounded demonstration with a row-count oracle

acceptance.condition: design reviewed by Pan; demonstration (if run) passes its oracle and its crash-replay check
